name: Sterling Powergensys Limited
about: Sterling Powergensys Limited engages in manufacturing of industrial boilers, thermal power plants in India. It offers commodities, electrolyser system and accessories, bearings; as well as solar solutions in solar products and EPC projects. The company was formerly known as Sterling Strips Limited and changed its name to Sterling Powergensys Limited in September 2014. Sterling Powergensys Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
